About the vendor network

The Lakefront Vendor Network is the procurement portal through which registered companies respond to City of Oskerry solicitations, track award notices, and maintain their partner records. Public sections are open to any visitor; partner sections require credentials issued by the records office.

Portal availability: Mon–Sun, 6 a.m.–11 p.m. Central. Scheduled maintenance windows are posted on this page one week in advance.

Getting started

Partner registration — submit Form PR-2 to register your company contact for the 2026 season.

Solicitations — browse the season's solicitations and their closing dates. No sign-in required.

Awards — public notices of awarded solicitations from the current season.

Records office — address, hours, and what the office validates.
